title: Subscription plans
description: Manage the global SaaS plan catalog, its commercial metadata, and availability.
catalogDescription: All active and inactive plans are visible to Platform Admins.

form.createDescription: A new plan is active immediately after creation.
form.editDescription: Plans with subscription history can only change availability.
form.codeLocked: The plan code cannot be changed after creation.
form.amountLimit: The converted API amount must not exceed {{max}} minor currency units.

entitlements.title: Entitlements
entitlements.description: Set the standard branch, user, and analytics limits for this plan.
entitlements.unknownDescription: These catalog values are read-only here and will be preserved when supported entitlements are saved.

availability.activateDescription: Make {{name}} available for future SaaS subscriptions.
availability.deactivateDescription: Hide {{name}} from future SaaS subscriptions. Existing history is not changed.
availability.reasonRequired: Enter a reason for this availability change.
availability.reasonTooLong: The reason must not exceed 500 characters.
